text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I misjudged when to make my move. 
That was far too early.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What... are you in such a rush for?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hey, are you listening to me?

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ……It's alright now.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What...?

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...The only reason I came to Tracen 
Academy is because I was a little good at 
running, and the race I happened to enter 
turned out to be kind of fun.

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"My mother never had a single race 
experience. My lineage doesn't have any 
special pedigree either."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What's your point?

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I'm telling you, I've got nothing!! 
Nothing I want to inherit, no grand will 
to uphold!!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I can't hold my head high like everyone 
else... not like you! There's no place for 
someone like me at this academy...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Is that all you have to say?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
............ Go home and rest for today. 
Don't let yourself catch a chill.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me. There are two things I wish to 
discuss.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
First is regarding permission to wear the 
'Racewear.'

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The other matter—concerns your plans for 
your next day off.

And so, on the next day off, I headed to 
the grounds as Air Groove had asked, and—

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Senpai. What are you trying to achieve by 
showing off that magnificent racing attire 
to me?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...The blue and yellow design is an 
inheritance from my mother, the 'Queen.'

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Adding my own image of an "Empress" to 
that is how this racing racewear came to 
be.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"To an Umamusume, racing silks are proof 
of their resolve, the crystallization of 
their will."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I chased after my mother's footsteps to 
stand here, and from here I shall advance, 
treating her as the ideal to pursue."

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Well, well. How admirable. But in that 
case, it has even less to do with me—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Would someone who abandoned their will to 
stand on the turf and wished to leave the 
Academy attack so aggressively?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Don't underestimate me. In your running, I 
felt nothing but your sheer desire to win!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...! But!! Even if you say that, 
there's no way I can—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Nothing, you say? Then run with me. Right 
here, right now.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I, the "Empress," shall surely become the 
"something" you aspire to.

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Sen... pai...

And Air Groove and the others sprinted. 
Catching up to her junior's earnest 
stride, Air Groove pulled ahead, overtook 
her—

She showed their eyes a back that was both 
beautiful and overwhelming.

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Haa, ngh...! Haa, haa...

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Haa, ngh...! Haa, haa...

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. Kind, yet cruel.

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"To plant hope in someone like me again, 
after all this...!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—Have you ever thought about why Umamusume 
are so fast?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Why are our legs so powerful as to 
captivate all who behold them? It is 
because...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
In order to dash endlessly along the path 
I have chosen for myself. ...That is what 
I believe.

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text: An Umamusume's... my legs...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"If there is hope, do not stop. Your legs 
have the power to move forward."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
And fear not to keep moving forward. Even 
should you fall along the rugged path—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
At that time, by your side, there will 
surely be a cane to support you.

...I felt as though Air Groove glanced 
over at me and smiled just a little.

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"...Truly. It makes me realize how much 
easier it would be if you just gave up on 
me."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If you truly wish to give up, I won't stop 
you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I shall not rush to those who look down 
and halt in their tracks. For to forge 
ever forward is my sole duty.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
However, as long as you continue to hold 
your head high, I will keep showing you 
the figure you ought to strive for.

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"...Senpai, do you never get lost? Do you 
never lose sight of who you're supposed to 
be?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I cannot say for certain that I won't. I 
have many shortcomings and deficiencies.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Still, I am certain she will never lose 
sight of who she is meant to be.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Because there is a mirror right beside me.

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text: A mirror...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes. A mirror that is always by my side... 
reflecting me, letting me confirm whether 
I am my ideal self.

...I felt as though Air Groove glanced 
over at me and smiled just a little.
